facts.text: I have been experimenting with bibimbap at home.
I recently tried a vegan version of bibimbap using tofu instead of beef.
I am interested in trying Japchae.
I am hosting a dinner party soon.
I want to serve a variety of dishes from different cuisines at my dinner party.
I like the idea of serving Japchae with Chana Masala and Falafel.
I want to serve a simple green salad with a light vinarette as a palate cleanser between dishes.
I think I will serve warm pita bread or naan on the side to mop up the sauces from the Chana Masala and Falafel.
I think I will make refreshing drinks to serve alongside the meal.
